misconception.why: I still lean on good prompts. But the rules file that survives the session, and the point that gaps get filled with generic guesses, tell me the file and the sources matter more than the wording. Nothing yet shows me how fourteen people share that file, so it isn't fully changed.

one_line: The look-back, cold-read and rules-file parts are worth the time, but the personal-site exercise is not my work, and the same filler paragraph appears fourteen times.
